title: error_status: no type distinction between request-level and method-level errors
description: error_status() in response.rs accepts any JmapError and builds an HTTP error response. request_error() also accepts any JmapError. But some JmapError variants (e.g. unknownMethod) are method-level errors that belong in an Invocation, not in a top-level HTTP response body. Nothing in the type system prevents a caller from passing a method-level error to request_error(), silently producing a malformed response. This is a footgun for consumers building new method handlers.
notes: Mitigation options: (a) split JmapError into RequestError and MethodError marker newtypes, (b) add #[doc] warnings on the fn signatures, (c) document which variants are safe as request-level. Option (b) is the lowest-risk change for a locked API.
